title: Happy Students
statement:
You are given `nums`, where `nums[i]` is the minimum group size needed for student `i` to be happy when selected, or the maximum group size allowed when not selected. If `k` students are selected, a selected student is happy when `k > nums[i]`; an unselected student is happy when `k < nums[i]`. Return the number of group sizes that make every student happy.

## Examples

```text
Input: nums = [1, 1]
Output: 2
```

```text
Input: nums = [6, 0, 3, 3, 6, 7, 2, 7]
Output: 3
```

## Constraints

- `1 <= nums.length <= 10^5`
- `0 <= nums[i] < nums.length`
